The bearer of Your words

The one who seeks forgiveness and assists those who obey You

The fearful and anxious one due to awe of You

Translation: O Allah, send Your blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: وَبَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: And bestow blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ وَرَحِمْتَ وَبَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَ آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
Translation: As You sent blessings, had mercy, and bestowed blessings upon Abraham and the family of Abraham
Indeed, You are Praiseworthy and Glorious
O Allah, send Your blessings upon the successors and the fortunate ones
And the martyrs and the Imams of guidance
O Allah, send Your blessings upon the substitutes and the supports
And the travelers and the worshippers
And the sincere ones and the ascetics
And the people of diligence and striving

Arabic text: وَاخْصُصْ مُحَمَّدًا وَأَهْلَ بَيْتِهِ بِأَفْضَلِ صَلَوَاتِكَ
Translation: And distinguish Muhammad and his household with the best of Your blessings
And the most abundant of Your honors

Arabic text: وَبَلِّغْ رُوحَهُ وَجَسَدَهُ مِنِّي تَحِيَّةً وَسَلامًا
Translation: And convey to his soul and body from me greetings and peace
And increase him in virtue, honor, and nobility

Arabic text: حَتّىٰ تُبَلِّغَهُ أَعْلىٰ دَرَجَاتِ أَهْلِ الشَّرَفِ
Translation: Until You make him reach the highest degrees of honor
Among the prophets and messengers
And the virtuous ones brought near [to You]

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلَى مَنْ سَمَّيْتُ وَمَنْ لَمْ أُسَمِّ
Translation: O Allah, send Your blessings upon those whom I have named and those whom I have not named
From among Your angels and prophets
And Your messengers and the people who obey You
And deliver my blessings to them and to their souls
And make them my brothers in You
And my helpers in supplicating to You
O Allah, I seek Your intercession with You
And Your generosity to [gain] Your generosity
And Your bounty to [gain] Your bounty
And Your mercy to [gain] Your mercy
And the people who obey You [to gain nearness] to You

Arabic text: وَأَسْأَلُكَ اَللّٰهُمَّ بِكُلِّ مَا سَأَلَكَ بِهِ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ
Translation: And I ask You, O Allah, by everything that anyone of them has asked You
By a noble request that was not rejected

Arabic text: وَبِمَا دَعَوْكَ بِهِ مِنْ دَعْوَةٍ مُجَابَةٍ غَيْرِ مُخَيَّبَةٍ
Translation: And by what they called upon You with from invocations that were answered and not disappointed

Arabic text: يَا جَلِيلُ يَا مُنِيلُ يَا جَمِيلُ

Arabic text: يَا مَنِيعُ يَا مُدِيلُ يَا مُحِيلُ

Arabic text: يَا نَفَّاعُ يَا رَؤُوفُ يَا عَطُوفُ
Translation: O Benefactor, O Most Kind, O Most Compassionate
O Sufficient, O Healer

O Mighty, O Compeller

Arabic text: يَا مُتَكَبِّرُ يَا سَلامُ يَا مُؤْمِنُ
Translation: O Proud, O Peace, O Granter of Security
O One, O Eternal
O Light, O Administrator
O Unique, O Single
O Holy, O Helper

Arabic text: يَا مُؤْنِسُ يَا بَاعِثُ يَا وَارِثُ

O Initiator, O Exalted

Arabic text: يَا مُصَوِّرُ يَا مُسَلِّمُ يَا مُتَحَبِّبُ

Arabic text: يَا قَدِيمُ يَا مُسَهِّلُ يَا مُيَسِّرُ
Translation: O Eternal, O Facilitator, O Easer
O Giver of Death, O Giver of Life

O Capable, O Causer

Arabic text: يَا مُغِيثُ يَا مُغْنِيْ يَا مُقْنِيْ
Translation: O Rescuer, O Enricher, O Satisfier

Arabic text: يَا خَالِقُ يَا رَاصِدُ يَا وَاحِدُ
Translation: O Creator, O Observer, O One
O Present, O Restorer
O Preserver, O Mighty

Arabic text: يَا غِيَاثُ يَا عَائِدُ يَا قَابِضُ
Translation: O Helper, O Returning, O Withholder
O One who is exalted and rose high
And is in the highest viewpoint
O One who is near and approaches
And is far and distant
And knows the secret and what is more hidden

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ إِلَيْهِ التَّدْبِيرُ وَلَهُ الْمَقَادِيرُ

Arabic text: وَيَا مَنِ الْعَسِيرُ عَلَيْهِ سَهْلٌ يَسِيرٌ
Translation: And to whom the difficult is easy and simple

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ هُوَ عَلَى مَا يَشَاءُ قَدِيرٌ
Translation: O One who has power over whatever He wills
O Sender of winds
O Cleaver of the dawn
O Resurrector of souls
O Possessor of generosity and magnanimity
O One who returns what has been lost
O Resurrector of the dead
O Gatherer of what is scattered

Arabic text: يَا رَازِقَ مَنْ يَشَاءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
Translation: O Provider for whom You will without account

Arabic text: وَيَا فَاعِلَ مَا يَشَاءُ كَيْفَ يَشَاءُ
Translation: And O Doer of what You will however You will
O Possessor of Majesty and Honor
O Ever-Living, O Self-Subsisting

Arabic text: يَا حَيُّ لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ

Arabic text: وَبَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ

Arabic text: كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ وَبَارَكْتَ وَرَحِمْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَ آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
Translation: As You sent blessings, bestowed blessings and had mercy upon Abraham and the family of Abraham
Indeed, You are Praiseworthy and Glorious
And have mercy upon my humility and my need

I call upon You with the supplication of one who is submissive and humble
Reverent and fearful
Anxious and distressed
Insignificant and lowly
Hungry and poor
Seeking refuge and protection
Acknowledging his sins
Seeking forgiveness for them
Submitting to his Lord
The supplication of one whose confidence has abandoned him
And whose loved ones have rejected him
And whose calamity has become great
The supplication of one who is burning with grief
Weak and insignificant
Miserable and submissive
Seeking Your protection
O Allah, I ask You, since You are the Sovereign

Arabic text: وَأَنَّكَ مَا تَشَاءُ مِنْ أَمْرٍ يَكُونُ
Translation: And whatever matter You will, it comes to be

And the Sacred House
And the Sacred City
And the Corner and the Station
And the great rituals

Arabic text: وَبِحَقِّ نَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ السَّلامُ
Translation: And by the right of Your Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him and his family
O One who granted Seth to Adam
And Ishmael and Isaac to Abraham

Arabic text: وَيَا مَنْ رَدَّ يُوسُفَ عَلَى يَعْقُوبَ
Translation: And O One who returned Joseph to Jacob

Arabic text: وَيَا مَنْ كَشَفَ بَعْدَ الْبَلاءِ ضُرَّ أَيُّوْبَ
Translation: And O One who removed the affliction from Job after his trial
O One who returned Moses to his mother
And increased Khidr in his knowledge
And O One who granted Solomon to David
And John to Zachariah
And Jesus to Mary
O Protector of the daughter of Shuaib
And O Guardian of the child of Moses' mother

Arabic text: أَسْأَلُك أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: I ask You to send Your blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
And that You forgive all my sins
And protect me from Your punishment
And make Your pleasure, Your safety
Your kindness, Your forgiveness, and Your Paradise obligatory for me

Arabic text: وَأَسْأَلُك أَنْ تَفُكَّ عَنِّيْ كُلَّ حَلْقَةٍ
Translation: And I ask You to break every chain
Between me and whoever would harm me
And to open every door for me
And to soften every difficulty for me
And to make easy every hardship for me
And to silence everyone who speaks evil of me
And to restrain every transgressor against me

Arabic text: وَتَكْبِتَ عَنِّيْ كُلَّ عَدُوٍّ لِيْ وَحَاسِدٍ
Translation: And to suppress every enemy and envier of mine
And to prevent every oppressor from me

Arabic text: وَتَكْفِيَنِيْ كُلَّ عَائِقٍ يَحُولُ بَيْنِيْ وَبَيْنَ حَاجَتِيْ
Translation: And to suffice me against every obstacle that comes between me and my need

Arabic text: وَيُحَاوِلُ أَنْ يُفَرِّقَ بَيْنِيْ وَبَيْنَ طَاعَتِكَ
Translation: And attempts to separate me from Your obedience
And discourages me from Your worship
O One who bridled the rebellious jinn
And subdued the insolent devils
And humbled the necks of the tyrants
And repelled the plots of the oppressors from the oppressed
I ask You by Your power over whatever You will
And Your making easy whatever You will however You will

Arabic text: أَنْ تَجْعَلَ قَضَاءَ حَاجَتِيْ فِيمَا تَشَاءُ
Translation: That You grant the fulfillment of my need in what You will
O Allah, to You I have prostrated
And in You I have believed
So have mercy on my humility and my need
And my striving and my imploring
And my destitution and my poverty before You, O Lord
